say:1:1035707001:1.text: Why? Because of the high and mighty acolytes at the temple!
say:1:1035707001:1.source_cn: 为什么？当然是因为圣堂那群家伙了！

say:2:1035707002:1.text: They said that I was blaspheming with my prayers about money. Called me greedy of all things, but I was just praying normally!
say:2:1035707002:1.source_cn: 我只是正常祈祷，他们却说我是在用贪婪亵渎女神！

say:3:1035707003:1.text: How pretentious! If they knew she would answer their prayers, they wouldn't hesitate to ask for money either!
say:3:1035707003:1.source_cn: 装模作样！我敢保证，如果女神能实现他们的愿望，他们才不...
